spec: a top-level lifetime in a space/3.1 file: persistence is not a 3.1 key
message: "lifetime" is not a space/3.1 key: it stays under x-dozable
hint: write x-dozable: { lifetime: standing } (standing or runs)
yaml:
doz: space/3.1
space: t
brief: B.md
owner: ada
lifetime: standing

spec: a 3.1 key in a space/3 file: the fix is the version line
message: "network" is a space/3.1 key: change the version line to doz: space/3.1
hint: this file says doz: space/3, which has no "network" here; space/3.1 reads every space/3 key the same
yaml:
doz: space/3
space: t
brief: B.md
owner: ada
network: standard

spec: a 3.1 brief in a space/3 file
message: "brief" is a space/3.1 key: change the version line to doz: space/3.1
hint: this file says doz: space/3, which has no "brief" here; space/3.1 reads every space/3 key the same
yaml:
doz: space/3
space: t
owner: ada
brief: { text: Fix the build }

spec: a folder's main in a space/3 file
message: "main" is a space/3.1 key: change the version line to doz: space/3.1
hint: this file says doz: space/3, which has no "main" here; space/3.1 reads every space/3 key the same
yaml:
doz: space/3
space: t
brief: B.md
owner: ada
folders:
  repo: { external: ~/r, main: true }

spec: an agent's restart in a space/3 file
message: "restart" is a space/3.1 key: change the version line to doz: space/3.1
hint: this file says doz: space/3, which has no "restart" here; space/3.1 reads every space/3 key the same
yaml:
doz: space/3
space: t
brief: B.md
owner: ada
agents:
  w: { kind: claude-code, isolation: fenced, restart: on-failure }

spec: a top-level lifetime in a space/3 file: unknown, as before
hint: persistence is declared under the top-level persist:, e.g. persist: { team-chat: { room: NAME } }; anything not listed lasts one run
yaml:
doz: space/3
space: t
brief: B.md
owner: ada
lifetime: standing

spec: a key and its x-dozable form
message: "network" is written twice: network: and x-dozable.network
hint: keep network: — the x-dozable form is read for this release only
yaml:
doz: space/3.1
space: t
brief: B.md
owner: ada
network: open
x-dozable: { network: locked }

message: the brief is written twice: brief: and x-dozable.brief
hint: keep one of them: brief: FILE, or x-dozable: { brief: { text: … } }

spec: a brief is its text or its file
message: brief is its text or its file, not both
hint: write brief: { text: "…" } or brief: { file: BRIEF.md }
yaml:
doz: space/3.1
space: t
owner: ada
brief: { text: a, file: B.md }

hint: a workspace has one main folder
yaml:
doz: space/3.1
space: t
brief: B.md
owner: ada
folders:
  a: { external: /a, main: true }
  b: { external: /b, main: true }

spec: params: is a template's, never a stored document's
hint: params: belongs to a template, never to a stored document
yaml:
doz: space/3.1
space: t
brief: B.md
owner: ada
about: { title: T, params: {} }

spec: a space-defaults/3.1 file holds what a space-defaults/3 one does
hint: a defaults file holds only persist, archive, approvals, agent_defaults and x-* keys; "lifetime" belongs in the space file
yaml:
doz: space/3.1
space: t
brief: B.md
owner: ada

message: the title is written twice: title: and about.title
hint: keep about: { title: … } — a top-level title: is read for this release only
yaml:
doz: space/3.1
space: t
brief: B.md
title: T
owner: ada
about: { title: U }

spec: an agent in an existing sandbox in a space/3 file
message: "external" is a space/3.1 key: change the version line to doz: space/3.1
hint: this file says doz: space/3, whose external agent is { bot: NAME }, { session: NAME } or a full name; { sandbox: NAME } is space/3.1's
yaml:
doz: space/3
space: t
brief: B.md
owner: ada
agents:
  r: { external: { sandbox: s } }
